events.info: An Ultimate Fairy Tale for the whole family with LIVE ORCHESTRA! Experience the enchanting world of The Sleeping Beauty in a breathtaking new production from World Ballet Company, featuring a LIVE orchestra. This magical performance features forty professional dancers, over 150 radiant costumes, stunning hand-crafted sets and multimedia effects. Tchaikovsky's glorious score will be performed live. Follow Princess Aurora from her joyful christening to the wicked fairy Carabosse's powerful curse, the kingdom's enchanted hundred-year sleep, and the magical kiss that awakens the sleeping beauty. From the iconic Rose Adagio to the grand wedding celebration, every moment is filled with beauty and wonder. Share an unforgettable evening where fairy tales come to life, love conquers darkness, and happily ever after awaits.
